grammar_title: 构词法(Word formation:派生 prefix/suffix · 合成 compounding · 转化 conversion)
source: 外研社(新标准)必修第一册 Unit 2 Using language:Review word formation(派生/合成/转化)。每题给一个语境句,选出在该语境中构词正确、意思贴切的词;零术语,答案唯一;句子地道、围绕探索英语主题。

points.point: 派生:加前缀/后缀(un-/in-/im- 表否定;-less/-ful;-ment/-ity/-ness;-ly;-ive)
points.overview: 给单词加前缀或后缀可得到意义或词性不同的新词:un-/in-/im- 多表否定(correct→incorrect);-less 表'没有'、-ful 表'充满'(harmless/harmful);-ment/-ity/-ness 多构成名词;-ly 多构成副词。按语境选意义和形式都对的派生词。

points.point: 合成:把两个词合成一个新词(homesick / homework / blackboard / subway 等)
points.overview: 把两个(或更多)简单词合在一起构成合成词,意思常可从两部分推出:home+sick=homesick(想家),black+board=blackboard(黑板),sub+way=subway(地铁)。按语境选意思贴切的那个合成词。

points.point: 转化:同一个词不变形,用作不同词性(名词/形容词→动词)
points.overview: 有些名词或形容词不改变拼写就能用作动词:water(水→浇水)、name(名字→命名)、calm(平静的→使平静)。转化后仍按句子需要选正确的动词形式;to / 情态动词 / 祈使句后用动词原形。

questions.stem: If a piece of information is not correct, we say it is ____.
questions.explanation: 表示'不正确'要在 correct 前加否定前缀 in-,且此处需形容词 → incorrect。

questions.stem: An action that does no harm at all is completely ____.
questions.explanation: '没有伤害'用后缀 -less;harmful 是'有害的'意思相反 → harmless。

questions.stem: She failed the exam, so she is feeling quite ____ about it today.
questions.explanation: 表示'不高兴'在 happy 前加 un-,此处需形容词 → unhappy。

questions.stem: After a year of practice, he has made great ____ in spoken English.
questions.explanation: great 后需名词,improve 加 -ment 构成名词 → improvement。

questions.stem: These two words look so alike that they are really ____.
questions.explanation: 形容事物'令人困惑'用 -ing 形容词;confused 指人感到困惑 → confusing。

questions.stem: I have just arrived, so all these school rules are still ____ to me.
questions.explanation: 表示'不熟悉的'需 un- 前缀的形容词 → unfamiliar。

questions.stem: On a clear night, thousands of stars are easily ____ to the eye.
questions.explanation: be 后需形容词'看得见的' → visible。

questions.stem: In the thick fog, the tall mountains were almost ____.
questions.explanation: visible 的否定前缀是 in-,其余前缀搭配不成词 → invisible。

questions.stem: Choosing the right words well shows a person's ____.
questions.explanation: person's 后需名词,create 加 -ity 构成名词 → creativity。

questions.stem: He found a very ____ way to memorise long English words.
questions.explanation: way 前需形容词 → creative。

questions.stem: The whole class showed great ____ when the results came out.
questions.explanation: great 后需名词,excite 加 -ment → excitement。

questions.stem: Such rude ____ in the library surprised everyone around.
questions.explanation: rude 后需名词,behave 的名词是 behaviour → behaviour。

questions.stem: The guide was patient and very ____ to every visitor.
questions.explanation: 表示'乐于帮助、有用的'用 -ful;helpless 是'无助的'意思相反 → helpful。

questions.stem: Without a map or a phone, the lost tourists felt completely ____.
questions.explanation: 表示'无助的、无能为力的'用 -less → helpless。

questions.stem: It is almost ____ to learn every single word in a dictionary.
questions.explanation: possible 的否定前缀是 im-,此处需形容词;impossibly 是副词 → impossible。

questions.stem: Knowing about word formation is very ____ when you read.
questions.explanation: 表示'有用的'用 -ful → useful。

questions.stem: A dictionary that you never open is almost ____.
questions.explanation: 表示'没用的'用 -less → useless。

questions.stem: The teacher explained the rule clearly and ____.
questions.explanation: 与 clearly 并列需副词,simple 加 -ly → simply。

questions.stem: Add the ending '-ly' to 'quick' and you get the adverb ____.
questions.explanation: quick 加副词后缀 -ly → quickly。

questions.stem: Learning where a word comes from makes it far more ____.
questions.explanation: 表示'有意义的'用 -ful,more 后需形容词 → meaningful。

questions.stem: Travelling by ship for the first time, she soon began to feel ____.
questions.explanation: 在海上(sea)晕的是 seasick(晕船)。

questions.stem: After a month studying abroad, the boy missed his family and felt ____.
questions.explanation: 想家(home)是 homesick。

questions.stem: Long flights make some passengers feel ____ high in the sky.
questions.explanation: 在空中(air)晕的是 airsick(晕机)。

questions.stem: On the bumpy mountain road, the children started to feel ____.
questions.explanation: 在车里(car)晕的是 carsick(晕车)。

questions.stem: A ____ is someone you keep in touch with by writing letters.
questions.explanation: 用笔(pen)联系的朋友是 penfriend(笔友)。

questions.stem: We must finish our ____ at home before the next English lesson.
questions.explanation: 在家做的功课是 homework。

questions.stem: My mother asked me to help with the ____, such as washing the dishes.
questions.explanation: 做家务(house)是 housework。

questions.stem: Saturday and Sunday together make up the ____.
questions.explanation: 一周的末尾(week+end)是 weekend(周末)。

questions.stem: Green plants need plenty of warm ____ to grow well.
questions.explanation: 植物需要阳光,sun+shine=sunshine。

questions.stem: The teacher wrote the new words on the ____ at the front of the room.
questions.explanation: 教室前写字的黑板是 blackboard。

questions.stem: I copied every new English word neatly into my ____.
questions.explanation: 记笔记的本子是 notebook(note+book)。

questions.stem: It suddenly began to rain, so I quickly put on my ____.
questions.explanation: 挡雨的外套是 raincoat(rain+coat)。

questions.stem: After the storm passed, a colourful ____ appeared in the sky.
questions.explanation: 雨后天空出现的是 rainbow(彩虹)。

questions.stem: Cars and buses speed along the wide ____ between the two cities.
questions.explanation: 城际间的宽阔大路是 highway(high+way)。

questions.stem: In a busy city, many people travel underground by ____.
questions.explanation: 地下(sub)的路是 subway(地铁)。

questions.stem: I clean my teeth every morning with a ____.
questions.explanation: 刷牙(tooth)用的刷子是 toothbrush。

questions.stem: We read about the latest news in this morning's ____.
questions.explanation: 登载新闻(news)的纸是 newspaper(报纸)。

questions.stem: My grandparents still live in my quiet little ____ in the south.
questions.explanation: 出生长大的小镇是 hometown(home+town,家乡)。

questions.stem: In summer she grows tall yellow ____ along the garden wall.
questions.explanation: 向着太阳(sun)的花是 sunflower(向日葵)。

questions.stem: After class, the boys kicked the ____ around the playground.
questions.explanation: 用脚(foot)踢的球是 football(足球)。

questions.stem: Remember to ____ the flowers in the garden every morning.
questions.explanation: water 由名词转化作动词'浇水';to 后用动词原形 → water。

questions.stem: Could you please ____ me that English dictionary on the shelf?
questions.explanation: hand 由名词转化作动词'递';情态动词后用原形 → hand。

questions.stem: They have decided to ____ their new baby after her grandmother.
questions.explanation: name 由名词转化作动词'给……取名';to 后用原形 → name。

questions.stem: Don't forget to ____ the front door when you leave the house.
questions.explanation: lock 由名词转化作动词'锁';to 后用原形 → lock。

questions.stem: I need to ____ a table for four at the restaurant tonight.
questions.explanation: book 由名词转化作动词'预订';to 后用原形 → book。

questions.stem: I will ____ you the new English word as soon as I get home.
questions.explanation: text 由名词转化作动词'发短信';will 后用原形 → text。

questions.stem: Please ____ me the file before noon so I can read it.
questions.explanation: email 由名词转化作动词'发邮件';祈使句用原形 → email。

questions.stem: I'll ____ you tonight to talk about our English project.
questions.explanation: phone 由名词转化作动词'打电话';will 后用原形 → phone。

questions.stem: We plan to ____ our house a bright shade of blue this summer.
questions.explanation: paint 由名词转化作动词'刷漆、涂';to 后用原形 → paint。

questions.stem: Dark clouds gathered, and soon it began to ____ heavily.
questions.explanation: rain 由名词转化作动词'下雨';to 后用原形 → rain。

questions.stem: It is so cold that it is going to ____ in the mountains tonight.
questions.explanation: snow 由名词转化作动词'下雪';be going to 后用原形 → snow。

questions.stem: Bright lamps will ____ the whole stage during the evening show.
questions.explanation: light 由名词转化作动词'照亮';will 后用原形 → light。

questions.stem: The head teacher will ____ the first prize to the winner tonight.
questions.explanation: present 由名词转化作动词'颁发、赠送';will 后用原形 → present。

questions.stem: The teacher asked us to ____ the new words in real sentences.
questions.explanation: use 作动词'使用';to 后用原形 → use。

questions.stem: Please ____ me at once if I make any mistakes in my English.
questions.explanation: correct 由形容词转化作动词'改正';祈使句用原形 → correct。

questions.stem: Take a deep breath and try to ____ down before the speech.
questions.explanation: calm 由形容词转化作动词'使平静';to 后用原形 → calm。

questions.stem: Hang the wet clothes outside to ____ them in the warm sun.
questions.explanation: dry 由形容词转化作动词'弄干';to 后用原形 → dry。

questions.stem: I really need to ____ my messy room this weekend.
questions.explanation: clean 由形容词转化作动词'打扫';to 后用原形 → clean。

questions.stem: Come inside and ____ yourself by the warm fire.
questions.explanation: warm 由形容词转化作动词'使暖和';祈使句用原形 → warm。

questions.stem: Please ____ the box completely before you pack the books.
questions.explanation: empty 由形容词转化作动词'倒空';祈使句用原形 → empty。
